about_the_game:
Cold Trigger is a thrilling third-person shooter (TPS) that immerses players in intense, action-packed battles. With dynamic gameplay and tactical combat, you'll face relentless opponents in varied environments, challenging your skill and strategy in real time.

With realistic 3D graphics and an intuitive control system, Cold Trigger offers an immersive, high-quality experience, ideal for fans of shooting games seeking adrenaline and constant challenges. Fast-paced action and strategic decisions are fundamental to survival, making each encounter unique.

The game features a diverse selection of scenarios, each with its own advantages and obstacles, demanding adaptation and quick thinking. Cold Trigger offers two main game modes:

Control Point: For those seeking competition to achieve victory in strategic objectives.

Elimination: For those who prefer team action, where the team that eliminates the most opponents wins.

Whether you're a strategist or a precision shooter, Cold Trigger offers opportunities for everyone to excel. Get ready to jump into action and prove who's the best!

🎯 Objectives and Challenges

Objectives: The main objective is to advance through hostile environments, completing specific missions that range from eliminating enemy forces and recovering crucial information to defending strategic positions. Players are challenged to use cover tactics, team coordination (in multiplayer mode), and resource management to overcome threats.

Challenges: Challenges include facing an intelligent and adaptive enemy AI, overcoming environmental obstacles, managing ammunition and health effectively, and making quick tactical decisions under pressure. The difficulty can be adjusted, offering an increasing challenge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i3 10100F / RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6700 or AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 or AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
